status: specified-only; cases are declarative input deltas, not run results
delta_rule: Clone the named complete supplied Scenario, change only the listed JSON-pointer values. For a poststate-based case, use the named mori-tests.json case's expected.post as the complete Scenario state/balances/liabilities and the listed complete inputs. Never derive expected output from actual execution.
rollback_rule: On every refusal there is no accepted Execution, no committed effects, no poststate and no success artifact. The borrowed Scenario remains byte-for-byte unchanged. Do not present the prestate as an emitted poststate. A private interpreter prefix, if any, is not a committed financial effect.
